description: Open-source Chatterbox family for expressive TTS and voice conversion, with emotion exaggeration control, fast generation, zero-shot voice cloning, and an integrated multilingual TTS path.

request.name: source_audio
request.description: Source speech path for voice conversion; required for VC when no request audio input is supplied.

request.name: target_voice
request.description: Target speaker reference path for voice conversion; required for VC when no request speaker audio is supplied.

request.name: exaggeration
request.description: Emotion and style exaggeration strength; default 0.5. Higher values produce more expressive speech and can speed up delivery.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: T3 classifier-free guidance scale; default 0.5. Lower values can improve pacing for fast reference speakers.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: T3 repetition penalty applied during speech-token sampling; default 1.2.

request.name: top_p
request.description: T3 nucleus sampling probability; default 1.0 disables top-p truncation.

request.name: s3gen_guidance_scale
request.description: S3Gen token-to-mel flow guidance scale; default 0.7 for TTS and VC.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum T3 speech tokens for TTS/clone generation; default 384.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Enable stochastic T3 speech-token sampling; default true.

request.name: stop_on_eos
request.description: Stop T3 speech-token generation on EOS; default true.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: S3Gen flow inference steps for voice conversion; default 10.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed for reproducible T3, S3Gen, and vocoder sampling; omitted uses a random seed.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum characters per generated text chunk; default 128.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking mode for long-form TTS; default word_budget.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared Chatterbox component weight storage type; default native.

session.name: t3_weight_type
session.description: T3 weight storage type; defaults to weight_type.

session.name: multilingual_t3
session.description: Multilingual T3 checkpoint used for non-English TTS; default v2.

session.name: conditionals_cache_slots
session.description: Prepared voice-condition cache slots; default 1, set 0 to disable.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Free non-conditional runtime graphs after each request chunk; default false.

session.name: encoder_condition_samples
session.description: Reference audio samples used by the voice encoder at 16 kHz; default 96000, equal to 6 seconds.

session.name: decoder_condition_samples
session.description: Reference audio samples used by the S3Gen decoder at 24 kHz; default 240000, equal to 10 seconds.

session.name: t3_speech_cond_prompt_len
session.description: Maximum T3 speech-token prompt length kept from reference conditioning; default 150.
